name: Alford Lake Camp
description_short: Residential summer camp for girls on Alford Lake in Hope, Maine, offering a 7-week full season or two 3.5-week sessions. Campers choose the activities they focus on, and tuition covers out-of-camp trips and riding.
refund_policy_summary: A $1,500 tuition deposit is due at registration. It is non-refundable and is credited toward tuition. Credit card convenience fees (3.5%) are also non-refundable. The page does not give a refund policy for the rest of the tuition.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Rates & Dates | Alford Lake Camp | Maine | United States

warnings: The early enrollment prices ($14,900 full / $10,700 half) were only available through 10/1/2026 and have expired as of today (2026-10-13). The prices recorded are the regular 2027 rates ($15,400 / $11,100), which took effect 10/2/2026.
The page refers to campers as 'she/her' and offers a sibling discount for each 'additional sister', so this appears to be a girls' camp. The page does not say so directly.
Extra costs on top of tuition: required camp clothing, transportation, lice check/treatment, and a 3.5% fee for paying by credit card. Sibling discount: $300 for each additional sister.
unknowns: Whether meals are included (likely for a residential camp, but not stated)
